- Boxmeer - 40 uur Are you technically minded, detail-oriented and passionate about quality? Then we are looking for you! As a Quality Control Technician in Boxmeer, you are responsible for monitoring and ensuring the quality of products and production processes. You identify deviations, investigate problems and ensure that products meet the required quality standards. What do we offer? - A 12-month assignment; - A 40-hour working week; - The candidate will be classified according to salary scale G. - A challenging position in a technical production environment; - Collaboration with various departments and suppliers; - The opportunity to contribute ideas for improving quality and production processes. You will identify deviations, investigate their causes and ensure that appropriate corrective measures are taken to prevent them from happening again. You will also carry out product inspections and audits, prepare reports and support colleagues with questions about quality requirements. In addition, you will actively contribute ideas for improving processes and inspection methods. You will work closely with the production, engineering and service departments, as well as suppliers.
